name: Rose City (an old Portland muni under firs and street trees)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours), same keys as pnw.json. Rose City Golf Course, NE Portland (course chat, 2026-11-13). From the OSIP 2024 photo: the turf a deep, slightly blue emerald, darker than pnw's (winter-wet ryegrass fairways and poa greens); rough a cool moss green; bunker sand a pale warm grey-tan; the three ponds (holes 10, 11, 14/15) dark slate. Trees: deep blue-green Douglas fir, olive Oregon white oak, bright bigleaf maple and, for a third of the broadleaf trees, the wine-red purple-leaf plums and copper beeches of the streets round the course (trees_rose_city.py; a drawing choice, the lidar gives only crown shape). Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
